**What's new in 2.1.2**

- Pages always print at their real size (1:1), so drawings keep their scale. A page with ink up to its edge is no longer shrunk to fit the printer's margins; what the printer cannot reach is cut off instead (e.g. a few millimetres at both sides of a page as wide as the roll). SumatraPDF, if chosen for A4/A3, is told to print at real size as well.

**Novo u 2.1.2**

- Stranice se uvijek ispisuju u stvarnoj veličini (1:1), pa crteži zadržavaju mjerilo. Stranica s crtežom do samog ruba više se ne smanjuje da stane u margine pisača; ono što pisač ne može ispisati se odreže (npr. nekoliko milimetara sa svake strane stranice široke kao rola). SumatraPDF, ako je odabran za A4/A3, također ispisuje u stvarnoj veličini.
